title: Dave W Possible NDE 3847
content: Back in 2000, I had a triple bypass operation. For the first time, I was taken out of bed, put in a reclining chair, and tilted back. I still had tubes coming out of my chest draining red fluid into a container. I closed my eyes and suddenly found myself in another place. I was a consciousness, and I could see all around me. I was in a very small close valley, almost a very wide ravine. It was in full Technicolor and seemed real. I could sense a light breeze; there was no sound. I was the only one there, and no one else had been there for a long, long time. I was on one side of this place. I could see up hill, downhill, and across to the other side. The grass seemed closely cut and green, and yet I felt like no one had been there for hundreds of years. It was a forgotten place, and I was totally alone. I felt like I was fixed in midair, I could sense and see fully everywhere I looked, but I couldn't move. All over on the slopes were small individual terraces, and on every one, there was the same monument. Each monument looked like a large stylized cast iron birds wing covered with brown patina. I would guess them to be eight or ten feet in length, I could see them above me, below me, and across from me on the slopes of the other side. I was looking at one right in front of me. The wing tip was pointing to me, and where it would have joined to a bird's body, was pointing away from me. I felt transfixed in midair as I looked, like I was a captive. Then way off in the distance, so faint I could hardly hear it, I heard a voice calling me. The cast iron wing I was focused on, began to slowly break up feather-by-feather, and each feather slowly floated toward this voice in a stream. I was finally allowed to move, and I followed. I felt relived. When I finally got back, there was a nurse standing there with some medication for me to take. I have never thought of this as an NDE. I saw no one else, no light, no tunnel, and actually, I don't know what to think of it. Perhaps my heart stopped for a few seconds, and then started up again. This was in 2000, and I still remember everything that happened vividly.

out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: Felt like a consciousness in another place, fixed/transfixed in midair and able to see all around.

environment.environment_other_detail: A very small close valley/wide ravine with closely cut green grass; slopes with small terraces; repeated monuments like large stylized cast iron bird wings covered with brown patina; sensed a light breeze; no sound.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Triple bypass operation; occurred when first taken out of bed into a reclining chair post-op.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Observed monuments (cast iron bird wings) breaking up feather-by-feather and floating toward a distant calling voice; then followed and returned to find a nurse present.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Closed eyes and suddenly was in another place (valley/ravine) without tunnel/light; later heard a distant voice and then was able to move and follow; then returned to normal awareness with nurse present.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Forgotten valley/ravine with many identical terrace monuments shaped like cast iron bird wings with brown patina; one wing broke up feather-by-feather and feathers floated toward a faint calling voice; experiencer felt captive/transfixed in midair and initially could not move.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I was a consciousness, and I could see all around me.” / “It was in full Technicolor and seemed real.” / “I felt transfixed in midair… but I couldn't move.” / “I heard a voice calling me.” / “I have never thought of this as an NDE. I saw no one else, no light, no tunnel… I don't know what to think of it.” /
